review.notes: Candidate 2 of 16: a great chunky cleaver sword with a hazard yellow crossguard plunged into a heap of riveted tin scrap, a laurel wreath hanging on the hilt and a dented tin helmet beside the blade; the Slayer's sword in the stone, wreath and helmet as Goblin scrap, lit from the left. 10 is a cleaner sword with a horned helmet but no heap; 14 has stray pixels; 0, 3, 5, 8 and 13 run to the canvas edge.

chibi-goblin-monument.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:GOBLIN
chibi-goblin-monument.notes: Reused candidate 14 of the Goblin Explorer sheet (explorer-a), no new PixelLab job (the US$5 limit left no room for obelisk-a). A crooked junk obelisk of riveted grey tin with a torn buff hide skirt round its foot and one hazard yellow four-pointed star on its front: the star the obelisk recipe asked for, with no compass ring and no spyglass, so it shows the Goblin builder and hides the achievement. Lit from the left. Engineer-a 2 (a tin and plank pillar) is the only other motif-free piece and has no hazard yellow; 0, 1 and 6 carry a spyglass or a ringed rose.

chibi-goblin-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:GOBLIN:CONQUEROR
chibi-goblin-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 10 of 16: a small arch of riveted light grey tin plates and grey-tan planks with an open gateway, a big hazard yellow laurel wreath on its top and a crossed cleaver and spear on its front; the Conqueror's arch and wreath as Goblin scrap, lit from the left. 13 to 15 are close; 0 to 9 and 11 measure lit from the right; 4, 5 and 7 have hazard yellow panels that crowd the wreath.

chibi-goblin-monument-engineer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:GOBLIN:ENGINEER
chibi-goblin-monument-engineer.notes: Candidate 0 of 16 (resumed after a dropped poll): a crooked pillar of riveted light grey tin with hazard yellow stripes, a big tin cogwheel standing at its top, a smaller one at its foot and a spanner bolted on; the Engineer's cogwheel in Goblin scrap, lit from the left. A weak row: most candidates are plain plank or tin pillars with no cog; 7 has a hazard yellow cog on top but no tools; 3, 11 and 15 heaps of grey cogs.

chibi-goblin-monument-explorer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:GOBLIN:EXPLORER
chibi-goblin-monument-explorer.notes: Candidate 8 of 16: a crooked obelisk of riveted light grey tin sheets with a big hazard yellow compass dial bolted on its front and a dented tin spyglass at its foot; the Explorer's compass and spyglass as Goblin scrap, lit from the left. 13 is close in grey planks; 0, 1, 6, 11 and 14 a loose yellow star; 4 and 7 buff hide patches; 12 and 15 heaps of planks.

chibi-goblin-monument-land-baron.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:GOBLIN:LAND_BARON
chibi-goblin-monument-land-baron.notes: Candidate 5 of 16: a stout boundary block of riveted light grey tin plates with a hazard yellow shield bearing a grinning face, a dented hazard yellow tin crown on its top and a crooked plank signpost with two arrow boards; the Land Baron's crowned boundary stone and signpost as Goblin scrap, lit from the left. Most others (1 to 3, 6, 7, 9 to 11, 13) run the signpost into the canvas edge (48 px wide); 14 has a skull.

chibi-goblin-monument-muster.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:GOBLIN:MUSTER
chibi-goblin-monument-muster.notes: Candidate 11 of 16: a crooked plank post hung with a dented tin pot lid, plank shields and a round wooden one, tied with rope, under a big curved horn across its top; the Muster's trophy of shields under a horn as Goblin scrap, lit from the left. The sixteen are near twins; 2, 6, 9 and 10 have a buff hide patch in place of a shield.
